news.headline: Japan expands Fukushima soil recycling project to Sendai, Saitama
news.summary:
Japan’s Environment Ministry says it plans to reuse soil collected in decontamination work near the disaster-stricken Fukushima Daiichi nuclear complex at national government branch offices in Miyagi and Saitama prefectures.
The government has already reused the soil at 12 sites in Tokyo since July
